about_contact_none: No contact details have been set up yet.
about_does_b: SafeFind replaces paper applications and informal messages with one record for each case, from the first report to the handover. The university's approval process stays as it is; the system keeps track of it.
about_lead: A digital lost and found case system for the BUP Security Cell.

how_sub: Select a step to see what you see and what the Security Cell does.

feat_h: Built around the Security Cell workflow
feat_match_b: Four factors are scored and combined into one number that staff can read. It is a suggestion; it never decides who owns an item.
feat_qr_b: A verified claim gets a single-use code with an expiry date. Staff complete the handover at the Security Cell and check your ID card.
feat_priv_b: The public board shows the type, a short title, the category, the building and the date. Descriptions, photos and contact details stay with the reporter and Security Cell staff.
feat_stats_b: Administrators see reports by month, category and status, and a map of where items are lost. Important actions are logged.
feat_note: Available in English and Bangla, in light and dark themes, on desktop and mobile.
why_h: From paper applications to one case record
